node_signature_b64.description: Signature over canonical LogEntry fields (RFC8785-JCS over the LogEntry object with node_signature_b64 omitted). Optional fields (e.g., sth_ref, time_beacon_digests) are covered if present.

server_timestamp_ms.description: Server wall-clock timestamp (ms since epoch); informational only—canonical ordering comes from STH/checkpoints.

time_beacon_digests.description: Optional content-addressed references to published hfv.time.beacon envelopes relevant to this entry/checkpoint epoch.
